title: Mega Man
intro: A route through the Robot Masters, the utility items worth collecting, and the final stages. Read the introduction for the controls and systems specific to this game.
facts: Weapons, utility items and final stages
primer: Mega Man 1 has six Robot Masters. You can run and jump, but cannot slide, charge shots or wall-jump. Special weapons consume energy; select a depleted weapon before collecting weapon energy.
There are no E-Tanks, Heart Tanks or armor parts. Health pickups restore your fixed life bar. Spikes kill even during the usual flashing period after a hit.
The original game has no passwords or saves. Use the collection’s save feature before closing. Revisited stages contain their boss again.
routeIntro: Start with Bomb Man, then follow the weakness chain. Guts Man’s Super Arm lets you collect Magnet Beam during the first Elec Man visit.

stages.name: Bomb Man
stages.tip: Keep enough space to see each bomb land. Shoot between throws and jump away from the blast.

stages.tip: Lift and throw the arena blocks. If you miss or exhaust them, ordinary shots still work.

stages.name: Elec Man
stages.tip: Keep your distance and throw the cutter when he approaches. His beam is dangerous; avoid trading hits.

items.name: Magnet Beam
items.text: During the tower climb, find the item behind large blocks on the right. Remove the blocks with Super Arm and collect it before continuing upward.
items.extra: Creates temporary platforms. Hold Fire to lengthen one, then release to place it.

stages.name: Ice Man
stages.tip: Watch the height of the three ice shots and jump through the gaps. Use Magnet Beam over the moving-platform pit.

stages.name: Fire Man
stages.tip: Fire ice shots from a safe distance and jump the flame waves. Avoid running back and forth into his repeated fire.

returnIntro: Collect the listed utility items before entering the fortress. Ordinary energy, lives and tanks are consumable supplies, not X-style permanent health upgrades.
completionText: Six weapons + Magnet Beam. Refill Magnet Beam before the fortress; there are no reserve health tanks.

warning.title: Collect Magnet Beam before Wily’s fortress.
warning.text: It is required for the normal route through Wily Stage 1. If you missed it, revisit Elec Man and remove the blocks with Super Arm or Thunder Beam.

sections.title: Wily’s fortress
paragraphs: Stage 1: use Magnet Beam to cross the climbing section. Against Yellow Devil, dodge the travelling blocks and hit the open eye with Thunder Beam. No pause-damage trick is needed.
Stage 2: fight Cut Man and Elec Man again. The Copy Robot uses your selected weapon; use the Buster or Thunder Beam and dodge before shooting.
Stage 3: against CWU-01P, use Buster shots on the earlier units, then Super Arm blocks on the faster ones. The blocks do not return after an ordinary death.
Stage 4: fight Bomb, Fire, Ice and Guts again. Use Fire Storm on Wily’s first machine and Thunder Beam on the exposed second form.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: Magnet Beam platforms expire. Make the next platform before the current one disappears and keep enough energy for the fortress.
Freeze a troublesome enemy with Ice Slasher while crossing a narrow ledge. Kill distant enemies before jumping where a hit would push you into a pit.
